research_notes: The current target is deliberately modestly above the prior 12m pass so coarse ascent can detect the failure region without huge jumps.
Two-minute steps balance search speed and bracket resolution at this stage.
One-minute refinement only becomes useful after an upper failed class exists.
Testing every minute from the start would waste samples without improving the current decision.
This search strategy remains efficient under limited automation turns.
A clean 14m close therefore justifies the planned 16m next probe.
